args.summary: Customer Hana Sato (verified) says order Q-7501 (Big Slice Pizza: large margherita pizza, garlic knots, Caesar salad, total $46.84 on Visa 4242) shows delivered but was never received. Delivery events show picked up 18:35 and handoff at 19:02 via left_at_door with photo proof PH-55120 (bag at door of apt 1204). Order was not late (handoff 12 min after promised time). No refunds or credits issued. Needs review of the delivery dispute despite photo proof.

events.text:
Thank you, Hana. Your identity is verified.

I looked into order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza. Here's what the records show:

- The courier picked it up at 6:35 PM and marked it handed off at 7:02 PM. The handoff was left at your apartment door (Apt 1204), and there is a photo of the bag at the door as proof of delivery.
- Because there is photo proof of delivery, I can't issue a refund or credit for this order myself. I've escalated it to a human specialist (reference ESC-700) to review the dispute. They will follow up with you within 24 hours.

If you can, check around your building, such as with neighbors or the front desk, in case the bag was moved. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Wait, there's a photo of the bag at my door? I never saw any bag there. I checked at 7:10 and there was nothing. Packages have gone missing in my building before, so I don't really trust that photo. I want a refund, not a 24 hour wait.

I understand why you're frustrated, Hana, and I'm sorry. Missing packages in your building would make the photo hard to trust.

I can't issue a refund myself for this order. When the courier's records show a handoff with photo proof and the customer says the order didn't arrive, our policy requires a human specialist to review it. I don't have the authority to override that, and I can't promise how it will be resolved.

Your case is already with the specialist (ESC-700), and they will follow up within 24 hours. When you talk to them, it will help to mention:

- You checked your door at about 7:10 PM and found nothing.
- Your building has had missing packages before.

If you find the order somewhere, such as with the building front desk or a neighbor, please let us know so the case can be updated.

I get that you can't refund it yourself, but I still want a refund, not a 24 hour wait. I checked at 7:10 and there was nothing at my door, so I really don't think the bag was there. I already asked the front desk and nobody has seen it, so this isn't something I can just sort out with the building.

I hear you, Hana, and I believe you that the bag wasn't at your door when you checked at 7:10 PM. I'm sorry the front desk couldn't help either.

I still can't issue the refund. Because the courier's records show a handoff with photo proof, only a human specialist can decide this dispute, and that decision is already in progress under ESC-700. Waiting for the specialist is the only path available to me right now.

If you'd rather speak to a person directly, I can flag your request for a human agent as well. Would you like me to do that?

Fine, I guess. The specialist can decide, but I want it noted that I'm not okay with waiting a day when I've been without my pizza and I checked my door right when it was supposed to be there. Yes, please flag it so someone can look at it sooner.

args.summary: Customer Hana Sato (verified) asked to speak to a person about order Q-7501, which is already escalated as delivery_dispute (ESC-700). She says the order was never received: she checked her door at about 7:10 PM and the bag was not there, and the front desk has not seen it. Delivery events show handoff at 19:02 left_at_door with photo PH-55120, which she disputes. She wants a refund now rather than waiting up to 24 hours, and asks for review sooner. No refunds or credits issued.
